mapper.sql: f.id, f.kind, f.party, f.walk_min, f.category, f.name, f.menu, COALESCE(f.review, '') AS review, f.example, COALESCE(f.photo, '') AS photo, f.sort_order, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.deleted_at, f.deleted_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM life_foods f WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE f.kind WHEN 'food' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.sort_order, f.id
SELECT , u.name AS deleted_by_name FROM life_foods f LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = f.deleted_by WHERE f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.deleted_at DESC, f.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO life_foods (kind, party, walk_min, category, name, menu, review, example, photo, sort_order) VALUES (#{kind}, #{party}, #{walkMin}, #{category}, #{name}, #{menu}, #{review}, #{example}, #{photo}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE life_foods SET kind = #{kind}, party = #{party}, walk_min = #{walkMin}, category = #{category}, name = #{name}, menu = #{menu}, review = #{review}, example = #{example}, photo = #{photo}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE life_foods SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_by = #{by} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE life_foods SET deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM life_foods WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
